stories.title: Steering failure caused tanker to crash into riverboat cruise ship, federal investigators say
stories.summary: Investigators said they are deliberately using the broad term "steering casualty" because they are still working to determine exactly what went wrong mechanically.

stories.title: Non-profit thanks tanker crash responders with meals
stories.summary: While investigators and emergency officials are hard at work, a local non-profit is thanking them by providing meals.

stories.title: Woman dead, man injured after being struck by train in St. Tammany Parish
stories.summary: It happened at the intersection of Hwy 11 and 2nd Street in Alton. St. Tammany fire officials reported the crash early Sunday morning.

stories.title: Second Mississippi River collision causes Chalmette Ferry suspension
stories.summary: The Chalmette-Lower Algiers ferry service remains suspended until further notice after a tugboat struck the Thomas Jefferson ferry overnight Friday.

stories.title: Four riverboat cruise ship crew members sue tanker management company
stories.summary: Four crew members aboard the American Heritage are now suing the owner and management company of the asphalt tanker that crashed into the cruise ship on Friday.

stories.title: Federal investigations underway into tanker crash with cruise ship
stories.summary: The NTSB says 16 federal investigators are on the scene.

stories.title: Maritime attorney explains legal implications of Port of New Orleans lawsuit after tanker crash
stories.summary: The Port of New Orleans is seeking more than $1 million after an asphalt tanker hit a cruise ship. A maritime attorney explains what the lawsuit could mean.

stories.title: Mandeville man faces murder charge after shooting, killing co-worker, STPSO says
stories.summary: Jared Schurr faces a second-degree murder charge after a co-worker was fatally shot at a construction site near Covington.

stories.title: Coroner identifies man killed by co-worker in Covington
stories.summary: A 37-year-old Covington man was identified after a co-worker shot and killed him at a construction site Friday.

stories.title: Man shoots, kills co-worker at construction site near Covington
stories.summary: The sheriff's office says they responded to reports of an incident Friday morning.

stories.title: Authorities looking for answers in murder of woman on Mandeville walking trail
stories.summary: The body of 24-year-old Lizeht Rodriguez was found Wednesday at the Northlake Nature Center.

stories.title: MSY flights still disrupted after nationwide grounding
stories.summary: Dozens of flights at MSY were canceled Friday night and Saturday morning, leaving some passengers facing another night in the city.
